# Eduporium

> Eduporium is an online reseller of STEM, STEAM, and maker education technology for K-12 classrooms.

Eduporium specializes in instructional technology including robotics kits, 3D printers, coding tools, drones, and makerspace equipment. The site serves educators looking to integrate hands-on technology and engineering into their curriculum.

## Key Topics

- STEM Education
- STEAM Learning
- Educational Robotics
- 3D Printing
- Coding Education
- Makerspace Equipment
- Bee-Bot
- Blue-Bot
- micro:bit
- Cricut Machines
- DJI Tello EDU
- Ozobot
- Hybrid Learning
- Classroom Technology
- STEM Products

## Robotics & Coding

- [Robotics & Coding](https://www.eduporium.com/robotics-coding.html): K-12 robotics and coding solutions: Bee-Bot, Blue-Bot, Wonder Workshop.
- [Robotics & Coding - Robotics](https://www.eduporium.com/robotics-coding/robotics.html): Grade-level robotics: Bee-Bot, Blue-Bot, InO-Bot from K-12 progression.
- [Coding Tools](https://www.eduporium.com/robotics-coding/coding.html): Coding classroom tools and robots for STEM learning across grade levels.
- [Drones for Education](https://www.eduporium.com/robotics-coding/drones.html): Educational drones: DJI Tello EDU, Discover Drones for STEM and CTE.
- [Drones and Coding](https://www.eduporium.com/robotics-coding/drones/drones.html): Programmable drones: DJI Tello EDU, CoDrone, Discover Drones kits.
- [Active STEM - Robotics & Coding](https://www.eduporium.com/robotics-coding/active-stem.html): Active STEM products: CoDrone, STEM Sports, educational robotics bundles.
- [Drone Accessories](https://www.eduporium.com/robotics-coding/drones/drone-accessories.html): Drone accessories: propellers, batteries, guards for Tello EDU, CoDrone.

## Makerspace & 3D Printing

- [Makerspace Tools](https://www.eduporium.com/makerspace.html): Makerspace section featuring 3D printers, circuitry kits, and design tools.
- [Makerspace - 3D Printers](https://www.eduporium.com/makerspace/3d-printers.html): Educational 3D printers catalog: LulzBot, MakerBot, filaments, curriculum.
- [3D Printing](https://www.eduporium.com/3d-printing.html): 3D printing catalog: LulzBot, MakerBot printers, filaments, accessories.
- [Makerspace - Robotics Kits](https://www.eduporium.com/makerspace/robotics.html): Educational robots for STEM curriculum: Ozobot, NAO Robot, challenge mats.
- [Circuitry Kits](https://www.eduporium.com/makerspace/circuitry.html): Electronics kits: Makey Makey, Snap Circuits, micro:bit for hands-on learning.
- [Maker Tools](https://www.eduporium.com/makerspace/maker-tools.html): Maker tools for STEAM learning: Cricut machines, music creation, design kits.
- [Machinery for Makerspaces](https://www.eduporium.com/makerspace/machinery.html): Makerspace machinery: 3D printers, scanners, laser printers, Cricut machines.
